'''Gola''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] student of [[Madame Vansitt's Charm Academy]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. She was a friend of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and fellow student [[Pala Kwi'teksa]].
